notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary, ANZ Indiefest, Cat Awareness, Pixel Expo and Video Nightz!
notes.notes:
[p][b]It's Courier Tale's 1 year anniversary![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Shout out to everyone who bought the game, played the game and reviewed the game![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't had a chance to grab Courier Tale yet, it is [b]50% off[/b] for the first time ever to celebrate the 1 year anniversary. And if you have played Courier Tale, why not give a review for the 1 year anniversary. It's currently ranked as "Positive".[/p][p][/p][p]To help celebrate the 1 year anniversary, Courier Tale is part of the [b]ANZ Indiefest 2025, Cat Awareness[/b] [b]Sale[/b] and [b]Pixel Expo[/b] Steam events this week.[/p][p][/p][p]But that's not the only thing to celebrate, because the next Studio Kraze game was revealed a few days ago as part of the ANZ Indie Showcase 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]My next game is called [b]Video Nightz[/b]... a video game about a video store, set in 1999![/p][previewyoutube="_3C8i28tX4k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]It’s 1999 and Y2K is upon us. You are the owner of an independent video store that a corporation is eyeing off to purchase. Help your customers find the perfect video by listening to their stories and decide what the future is for your video store.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]You can wishlist Video Nightz on Steam now...[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807430/Video_Nightz/"][/dynamiclink]
The Video Nightz demo will premiere at [b]Pixel Expo this weekend, 13 + 14 September[/b]. It's Western Australia's biggest animation and gaming convention, taking place at Perth Convention Centre. Courier Tale will be there as well of course, so if you're heading to Pixel Expo, drop by booth 46 and say hi. Check out [url="https://www.pixelexpo.org.au/"]https://www.pixelexpo.org.au/[/url] for more info.

Don't forget to join the [b]Studio Kraze discord[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/NTHQYFW"]https://discord.gg/NTHQYFW[/url] and follow [b]@studiokraze[/b] and [b]@videonightz[/b] on your favourite social spamming network.

Thanks again for playing Courier Tale and I hope you enjoy Video Nightz too![/p]

notes.title: Courier Tale Wins A WA Screen Culture Award!
notes.notes:
Courier Tale has won the Western Australian Screen Culture Award for game design!

The WASCAs took place at Luna Palace Cinemas on Sunday 1st December and is Western Australia’s awards night celebrating the local TV, Film and Games industry. The full list of awards winners can be found on the WA Screen Culture Awards website: [url=https://wascreencultureawards.com.au/2024-winners/]https://wascreencultureawards.com.au/2024-winners/[/url]

Courier Tale is currently 20% off as part of the Steam Autumn sale until 5th December and the upcoming ANZ Indie Showcase running from 7th – 10th December on Steam.

[i]Photo credit: Anthony Tran[/i]

notes.title: Courier Tale At Perth Games Festival 2023 As Part Of WA Games Week | 23 Sep 2023
notes.notes:
Courier Tale returns to Perth Games Festival for a 3rd round! I’ve probably said this before, but this will likely be the last event before the release of Courier Tale (though there’s still much work to be done).

Perth Games Festival is a bit different this year. It’s happening at the Esplanade Hotel in Fremantle. Tickets are $10, kids are free. It goes down on Saturday 23 September 2023 from 10am – 4pm. Not only can you check out Courier Tale, but there will also be a heap of Western Australian video games, tabletop games and VR experiences to check out.

It is part of the first ever WA Games week which runs from 17-23 September and features the Level Her Up game jam, industry talks, Immerse Connect Conference, and of course Perth Games Festival. You might even find Courier Tale featured on the WA Games Week website and promo video…

For more info or to buy tickets go to [url=https://www.wagamesweek.com/][b]www.wagamesweek.com[/b][/url] or check out the Perth Games Festival [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/events/796533848787706]facebook event[/url][/b]
